stem:
Read this quotation from paragraph 4.

I had never seen such stubbornness for so long in my daughter, even at her young age. I was shocked. These red American apples had such scary appeal to the young children.

What does this quotation reveal about the narrator's conflict?

options.label: F
options.text: He is displeased with his daughter’s rebellious behavior.

options.label: G
options.text: He is stunned by how easily children are enticed by the appearance of the apples.

options.label: H
options.text: He is uncertain about whether to buy his daughter what she wants.

options.label: J
options.text: He is angry that the American apples are being marketed specifically to children.
